100 E. La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, CA
WHEN ADDRESSING COUNCIL PLEASE COMPLETE A SPEAKER'S CARD BEFORE LEAVING COUNCIL CHAMBERS
AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.
&
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.
Monday, May 5, 2014
06:30 p.m.
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Administrative Conference Room 106
I.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS:
II.
CLOSED SESSION:
a.
Conference with Labor Negotiator per Government Code Section 54957.6 - Agency Representative: Jim Sadro, Interim City Manager; Employee Organizations: Police Sworn Employees, Police Civilian Employees, La Habra Municipal Employees Association, General Services Employees, Professional Employees, and Management and Executive Management Groups.
b.
Public employee evaluation per Government Code Section 54957 - Title: Interim City Manager.
III.
ADJOURNMENT:
Except as otherwise provided by law, no action shall be taken on any item not appearing in the foregoing agenda. A copy of the full agenda packet is available for public review at the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours or on the City's webpage at http://www.lahabraca.gov/.
Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Authority/Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at 110 East La Habra Boulevard, La Habra, during normal business hours
In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.
DECLARATION: This agenda was posted on the Bulletin Boards outside of the south entrance of City Hall and Council Chamber, where completely accessible to the public, at least 72 hours in advance of the CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING 5:30 P.M.
&
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.
Meeting.
REGULAR MEETING 6:30 P.M.:
CALL TO ORDER: Council Chambers
INVOCATION: City Attorney Jones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Councilmember Shaw
ROLL CALL:
CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT:
I.
PROCLAMATIONS/PRESENTATIONS:
a.
Proclamation - National Public Works Week, May 18 - 24, 2014, in La Habra.
Ia PW National PW Week Proc
b.
Proclamation - Arbor Day Earth Day April 26, 2014, in La Habra.
Ib PW Arbor Day Earth Day Proc
c.
Proclamation - National Police Week, May 11 - 17, 2014, in La Habra.
Ic PD National Police Week 2014
d.
Presentation of Certificates in recognition of Miss La Habra 2014 and her Court: Miss La Habra - Allison Staumont, Princesses Alondra Gonzalez, Victoria Johnson, Jessica Maidlow, Arlene Orozco.
Id CM Cert Miss La Habra Princess
e.
Dr. Doffoney, North Orange County Community College District, presentation on district programming.
f.
Lisa Telles, Transportation Corridor Agencies, presentation on TCA's internal changes.
g.
Presentation of a check from the La Habra Host Lions to the City of La Habra.
II.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
This is the time for the public to address any item of City Council/Authority/Agency business NOT appearing on this Agenda. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each. The total time period for public comment is 30 minutes.
(Note: Per Government Code Section 54954.3(a), the City Council/Authority/Agency cannot take action or express a consensus of approval or disapproval on any public comments regarding matters which do not appear on the printed agenda.)
III.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
All matters on Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a Councilmember/Director or member of the audience requests separate action or removal of an item. Removed items will be considered following the Consent Calendar portion of this agenda. Members of the audience will have the opportunity to address Authority on removed items at that time. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
A.
PROPOSED ITEMS:
1.
PROCEDURAL WAIVER: Waive reading in full of resolutions and ordinances and approval and adoption of same by reading title only.
2.
Approve City Council Minutes of:
a.
November 18, 2013
III2a CC 20131118m cc
b.
April 22, 2014
III2b CC 20140422m cc
3.
Approve and authorize Interim City Manager to enter into agreement with JMDiaz, Inc. of City of Industry, California in the amount of $468,892 to provide design architectural/engineering services for the La Habra Union Pacific Rail Line Bikeway Project; and authorize staff to issue a purchase order to JMDiaz, Inc. in the amount of $515,781 that includes a 10% contingency.
III3 UPRR Bikeway
4.
Approve and authorize Interim City Manager to enter into agreement with Fehr & Peers Transportation Consultants of Anaheim, California, in the amount of $78,210 to provide professional engineering services for the City of La Habra Bikeway Master Plan Update Project; and authorize staff to issue a purchase order to Fehr & Peers Transportation Consultants in the amount of $86,030 that includes a 10% Contingency.
III4 CD Bikeway Mst Pln
5.
Approve and authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Albert Grover & Associates of Fullerton, California in the annual amount of $75,600 to provide professional consultant traffic and transportation engineering services for the City of La Habra for Fiscal Year 2014-2015 through Fiscal Year 2019-2020; and authorize staff to issue a purchase order to Albert Grover & Associates for Fiscal Year 2014-2015 in the amount of $75,600.
III5 CD Traffic Conslt
6.
Authorize the City Manager to execute a purchase order for forty (40) Panasonic Toughbook mobile data computers (MDCs), to include all the necessary hardware, antennas, cabling, and installation service from the mobile computer vendor CDCE, Inc., of Yorba Linda, in the amount not to exceed $287,852.80.
III6 PD Mobile Data Comp
7.
WARRANTS: Approve Nos. 00096095 through 00096266 totaling $2,306,916.52.
III7 FAS Warrants 20140505
IV.
CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS REMOVED FOR SEPARATE DISCUSSION:
V.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
NOTE: If a challenge is made by any party in court from actions arising out of a public hearing, you may be limited to raising only those issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice or in written correspondence delivered at the public hearing or prior thereto.
1.
Consider Amendments to Title 10 of the La Habra Municipal Code establishing regulations for food vending vehicles.
a.
APPROVE FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 1751 ENTITLED: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LA HABRA REPEALING SECTION 10.20.100 (VENDING VEHICLES) OF CHAPTER 10.20 (STOPPING, STANDING AND PARKING) OF TITLE 10 (VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC) AND ADDING CHAPTER 10.58 (FOOD VENDING VEHICLES) RELATING TO FOOD VENDING VEHICLES.
V1 CD Food Trk Vending
VI.
CONSIDERATION ITEMS:
Any member of the audience may request to address the City Council/Authority/Agency on any Consideration Item, prior to the City Council/Authority/Agency taking a final vote on the Item. The Mayor will invite interested persons to come forward to the podium and speak as each Item is called. Speakers must limit their comments to three (3) minutes each.
1.
Consider the name "The City Trek" for the new compressed natural gas (CNG) circulator bus system that OCTA will operate in the La Habra beginning August 2014, in accordance with the new Measure M "Project V Program."
a.
In accordance with the new Measure M "Project V Program," it is recommended that the City Council adopt the name "The City Trek" for the new compressed natural gas (CNG) circulator bus system that the Orange County Transportation Authority (OCTA) will operate in the La Habra beginning August 2014.
VI1 CM OCTA Bus branding
VII.
MAYOR'S COMMUNITY CALENDAR:
VII CM MCC 05-05-14
VIII.
COMMENTS FROM STAFF:
IX.
COMMENTS FROM COUNCILMEMBERS:
X.
ADJOURNMENT: Adjourned to Monday, May 19, 2014, at 5:30 p.m. in the Administrative Conference Room 106, followed by the Regular Meeting at 6:30 p.m. in the City Council Chambers.

In accordance with the Federal Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, should you require a disability-related modification or accommodation, including auxiliary aids or services to participate in the meeting due to a disability, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (562) 383-4030.
